hints.title: Subarray Decomposition
hints.text: Consider decomposing the problem into choosing j non-overlapping segments from the prefix up to index i.

hints.title: Prefix Sum Optimization
hints.text: The sum of a segment nums[p..i-1] can be computed as prefix[i] - prefix[p] with length at least m implying p <= i - m.

hints.title: Running Best Offset
hints.text: Maintain max_val tracking max(dp[p][j - 1] - prefix[p]) to perform O(1) state transitions instead of re-scanning previous boundaries.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Iterates through n elements across k layers with O(1) running prefix maximum transitions.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Re-scanning all candidate start indices p for each subarray takes O(n^2 * k) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Maintaining the optimal prefix difference offset eliminates the nested loop over p.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Formulate 2D state (i, j) and optimize transition using prefix sum difference tracking.
